content.text:
I found 9 active skincare ads that include Germany (DE) in their target countries. These are a sample, not a full list: the ad library can't filter by country, so I went through the 50 newest active skincare ads and kept the ones that list DE. All 9 started on 2026-10-30.

| ID | Brand | Headline | Format | Other countries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 21071 | Silver Nest | Award-winning cleanser for small spaces | Video | AU, BR, MX |
| 21020 | Silver Nest | Why thousands switched to this serum | Image | US, CA, IT |
| 20333 | Silver Nest | The SPF you will actually use | Video | GB, IT, IE |
| 20993 | Daily Craft | Bestselling eye cream for travel | Image | AU, NZ |
| 20846 | Bright Club | Our lightweight glow just dropped | Image | US, AU, JP |
| 20774 | Kind Collective | Premium toner for travel | Video | FR, IT, JP |
| 20710 | Peak Studio | Save 30% on the serum everyone is talking about | Carousel | CA |
| 20588 | Peak Studio | Save 40% on the toner everyone is talking about | Image | BR |
| 20647 | Silver Supply | Vegan serum for every budget | Image | CA, MX, JP |

**What I noticed:**
- **Repeat brands:** Silver Nest has 3 of the 9 ads, more than any other brand, and Peak Studio has 2.
- **None target only Germany:** every ad also runs in other countries. Peak Studio's two ads are the narrowest, each running in just one other country.
- **Common messages:** discounts ("Save 30–40%"), social proof ("Why thousands switched", star ratings), urgency ("Limited stock") and a cross-sell line ("Pair it with our…").
- **No spend data:** the library has no data on spend or reach, so I can't say which of these ads gets the most exposure in Germany.

I can go through more pages for a fuller list, narrow it to a format or product such as SPF or serum, or pull the full text of any of these ads.
